results.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
results.overview: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

results.title: Nomad Shadow
results.overview: A young Sahrawi woman faces deportation to Western Sahara, struggling to readjust to her homeland and confront family tensions sparked by her earlier departure.

results.title: Pooja Meri Jaan
results.overview: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

results.title: Nine Times Fired
results.overview: The film portrays the journey of Jeong Gyu-ji, who has faced nine layoffs from different jobs, and her growth throughout the experience.

results.title: The Children of Kozara
results.overview: Based on the novel of Arsen Diklić which describes the horrors of concentration camp Jasenovac.

results.title: Luccica
results.overview: In this modern opera, a couple eagerly enter their married lives by renovating an old Victorian they hope will become their home. But tragedy strikes when the young wife unexpectedly commits suicide-right before her husband's eyes. Little did they know, the house was already inhabited by a ghostly apparition seeking revenge on the innocent couple for her own unfortunate life and untimely death. And she wants the husband too. Like a siren, she uses his former love's own voice to lure him to his death in exchange for a more complete visage in the afterlife.

results.title: The Third Murder
results.overview: When businessman Boban is murdered in the same manner as drug peddler Justin, DYSP Christy brings in ex-cop Swamy, an expert in serial killer cases. Their investigation leads to Aditya, a troubled teenager caught in conflict with his eccentric father, as hidden motives emerge and a deadly hunt begins to stop a third murder.

results.title: Journey
results.overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

results.title: Time Is A Circle
results.overview: In three whimsical parallel worlds, three individuals seek employment in a field based on their passions. One thinks slowly, one fast, and one backwards. When their ambitions are tempered by practicality, they each face unique difficulties in their menial jobs as their inner world clashes with the one surrounding them. How does one cope with a world fundamentally alien? And if they can make a change, are they destined to create the same system again, as if time were a circle? Inspired by Alan Lightman's novel "Einstein's Dreams."  Originally presented as a three-screen installation at The Well as part of the 2026 FotoFocus Biennial. Created during The Well's True Body Project youth apprenticeship in collaboration with 1001 Colors and FotoFocus in Summer 2026.

results.title: Player 4Ps
results.overview: Jester, an 11-year-old 4Ps beneficiary (Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps), a national social welfare initiative in the Philippines). He spends his time playing an online game called MVerse at a local Pisonet Shop in their place. What begins as an ordinary game slowly exposes him to an online exploitation scheme disguised as a gaming opportunity. As Jester becomes drawn deeper into the trap, Dan, a Pisonet owner who recently attended a seminar, notices something unusual and takes action. With the scheme eventually exposed and those responsible for the exploitation arrested, Jester later receives counseling and psychosocial support and continues his education through Dan’s help.

results.title: THE MASCOT
results.overview: In the late 70s, Paul Woelbing asked his dad if there'd ever be a job for him at the family company. His dad said, "No, I don't think so. What would you do?"  So Paul went to the East Coast and taught school. Then he came home.  Today he co-owns Carma Laboratories, the company behind Carmex, with his brother Eric. Their grandfather invented it during the Depression after losing his job. He picked a name that means nothing and a color that stood out on the shelf. Then he drove the Midwest, giving pharmacies a free dozen with a stamped reorder card. If it doesn't sell, throw it out. If it does, here's the card.  That's how it was built. This is how it's been carried: 100% family-owned, no outside investors, by design. One of America's top places to work seven years running. And a co-owner who calls himself the mascot.

results.title: Propaganda Team. The Grey Area
results.overview: The film is dedicated to front-line propaganda groups that performed during the Great Patriotic War practically on the line of combat contact.

results.title: Moon Girl
results.overview: The film tells about the times when the rainbow sang and the animals talked to the children. There was a girl who lived with an evil and greedy shaman. The girl had little strength, but she had a lot to do. The girl had a friend, a Bear, who helped and supported her in everything. The shaman did not like this friendship and he killed the bear.

results.title: Ideal
results.overview: A meticulous buyer came to the market in search of the perfect watermelon...

results.title: Fish
results.overview: A girl and her mother bought live fish at the market…

results.title: Chekhov Sakhalin
results.overview: The painting is a visual and anthropological study linking together the literary legacy of Anton Pavlovich Chekhov (his famous book of travel notes "Sakhalin Island") and the modern life of the island.

results.title: Phenomenon of Arthur
results.overview: The film tells about Artur Dalaloyan, the Olympic champion in artistic gymnastics in the team competition at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021. Arthur performed a miracle – three months after tearing his Achilles tendon, contrary to doctors' predictions, he not only returned to the sport, but also won Olympic gold together with his teammates.

results.title: untitled (clouds)
results.overview: "Through manipulations of density, processes such as coalescence (cloud formation), and evaporation (cloud disintegration) can occur in sonic form." - CR

results.title: Christmas at the Interlaken
results.overview: Seven strangers attend an exclusive holiday party at a historic inn during a heavy winter storm, only to find themselves mysteriously trapped inside. They soon discover they cannot leave until each person confronts their past and finds what they have been truly searching for.
